# SendFn

> Self-hosted email, SMS, WhatsApp, and push delivery with provider adapters.

## Documentation

- [Administration](https://sendfn.com/docs/administration) — Integrate SendFn into a host control plane.
- [Channels](https://sendfn.com/docs/channels) — Send email, SMS, WhatsApp, and push with the TypeScript SDK.
- [Getting started](https://sendfn.com/docs/getting-started) — Initialize a TypeScript client with a database and provider.
- [HTTP API](https://sendfn.com/docs/http-api) — Expose the optional router with an admin key.
- [Idempotent email sends](https://sendfn.com/docs/idempotency) — Use stable keys for retried outbound requests.
- [SendFn](https://sendfn.com/docs) — Self-hosted communications with provider adapters and persistence.
- [Persistence and events](https://sendfn.com/docs/persistence-and-events) — Understand records, suppressions, and delivery lifecycle.
- [Providers](https://sendfn.com/docs/providers) — Inject delivery adapters and keep credentials in your deployment.
- [Python SDK](https://sendfn.com/docs/python) — Install channel extras and configure a Python client.
- [SDK reference](https://sendfn.com/docs/reference) — Source package guides for TypeScript and Python.
- [Python SDK source guide](https://sendfn.com/docs/reference/python) — Current source README for the python package.
- [TypeScript SDK source guide](https://sendfn.com/docs/reference/typescript) — Current source README for the TypeScript package.
- [SES webhooks](https://sendfn.com/docs/webhooks) — Verify SNS messages before changing delivery state.
